capabilities: Configure university, degree program, current semester, and academic year
Track subject tasks with strike-through checklists, due dates, grades, and weights
Display a real-time semester progress bar across enrolled subjects
Export a full semester curriculum and task progress as a Markdown note
Archive completed semesters and reset for the next academic cycle
extras: The listing carries a note that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README describes a stylized 'Luxury Cyber' interface and automatic English/Spanish localization.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for managing a university semester: subjects, task checklists with due dates and grades, progress tracking, and end-of-term archiving.
summary: Semester manager that tracks university subjects, checklist tasks with grades, exports semester reports, and archives completed cycles.
